sources.title: moonshine-ai/moonshine-streaming-small · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the model card for the Moonshine Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) models trained and released by Useful Sensors. Moonshine Streaming pairs a lightweight 50~Hz audio frontend with a sliding-window Transformer encoder to deliver low-latency streaming ASR on edge-class hardware.
